scenes.event: Wyatt discovers a mysterious cassette tape in a record store
scenes.description: Wyatt Brooks, a 9-year-old boy with a passion for music and discovery, is in a small record store with his mother. He is drawn to a unique, colorful cassette tape cover with strange symbols. His mother, a practical and caring woman, is nearby, waiting while Wyatt explores.

characters.name: Wyatt Brooks
characters.description: A curious and enthusiastic 9-year-old boy with a love for music and unique styles. He is thoughtful and trying to balance his interests with what adults suggest.; years old, male, child, 9 years old; Occupation: Elementary school student; Personality: Curious, Enthusiastic, Thoughtful; Values: Individuality, Exploration, Respect for authority; Interests: Music, Discovery, Unique styles; Experiences: Visiting a record store, Interacting with adults, Making personal choices

characters.name: Mrs. Brooks
characters.description: Wyatt's mother, a kind but cautious woman who wants the best for her son; Female; Age: 38; Occupation: Elementary school teacher; Personality: Compassionate, observant, pragmatic; Values: Family, safety, curiosity with caution; Interests: Music, classic literature, community events; Experiences: Raised Wyatt as a single parent after a difficult divorce, volunteered at the local library, attended parent-teacher workshops on child development.
characters.position: Standing near the entrance of the store

characters.name: Mr. Thompson
characters.description: A middle-aged record store clerk who is friendly and well-intentioned; Male; Age: 45; Occupation: Record Store Clerk and Part-Time Music Teacher; Personality: Helpful, slightly awkward, concerned, nostalgic, patient; Values: Family, tradition, community; Interests: Classic rock, vinyl restoration, mentoring young people; Experiences: Managed the same record store for over 20 years, taught guitar lessons to local children, lost his own son to a music-related accident years ago.

actions.action: Points to a cassette tape with an unusual cover
actions.dialogue: Mom, what kind of music is this? It looks cool!

actions.action: Walks over to Wyatt and looks at the tape
actions.dialogue: That's... interesting, Wyatt. I'm not sure what it is, but maybe it's not the best choice for you.

actions.action: Approaches Wyatt with a children's music cassette
actions.dialogue: Hey, Wyatt, how about this one? It's a fun collection of songs for kids like you.

actions.action: Looks back at the mysterious tape, then at the children's cassette
actions.dialogue: But I really like the other one. It looks different from everything else.

actions.action: Sighs and gently places her hand on Wyatt's shoulder
actions.dialogue: I know you're curious, and that's great. But maybe we should stick with something more familiar for now.

actions.action: Smiles warmly and offers to play the children's tape
actions.dialogue: Let me play this one for you. It's got some fun songs that you might enjoy more.
Okay... I guess I can listen to it. But I still want to know what that other one is.

scenes.plot: Wyatt is drawn to a unique cassette tape in a record store, but his mother and the clerk suggest a more conventional children's music option. He must decide whether to follow their guidance or pursue his own curiosity.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the tension between self-expression and respect for authority in a child's decision-making process.
